text:
claire: Heads-up — saw a consistent ~10-15ms tail on host pre-parse for streaming calls after yesterday's kernel-selector change. Mostly visible at p95 for 8k-16k prompt sizes.

josh: ugh. which commit? any repro?

claire: landed by @josh yesterday (kernel selector: prefer-avx512 for l2 pattern). repro locally on dev-box with k8s canary.

liam: can you paste the flame or perf snippet?

claire: pasted small `perf top` snapshot, but the interesting bit is lots of time in `utf8_normalize` and `frame_serialize_smallwrite` when streaming. stack shows parse -> normalize -> writev path.

claire: ```
# simplified callgraph (p95 sample)
parse_request -> utf8_normalize -> token_preflight -> kvcache_lookup (miss) -> frame_serialize_smallwrite -> grpc_writev
```

perf-bot: perf CI regression: host_preparse_latency increased by 12.3% on canary vs main (daily job). Trace id: perf/175000/abi-check.

josh: interesting — kernel selector could be changing vectorized path that increases small-buffer churn for proto framing. maybe it changed alignment assumptions so normalize does extra copies.

liam: also saw increased syscall count on the write path (more small writes). tcp coalesce settings in the proxy might be worse with this kernel path.

claire: confirmed syscall spike: `strace -c` shows write syscalls doubled for streaming requests in the canary.

claire: quick patch idea: 1) revert kernel selector for host-preparse path 2) add a fast-path in parse for already-normalized ascii to avoid normalize copy 3) enable writev coalesce in proxy for small frames

josh: can we scope revert to only streaming ingress? I want to keep selector for batch decode where it helped.

liam: yes, we can gate by route: if request has Streaming:true then prefer legacy selector. cheap check in selector conf.

sre-oncall: rolling canary has been paused, we should also add a metric to show `kvcache_hit` correlation — misses were slightly higher on canary which may amplify normalize cost.

claire: added a quick trace log snippet to the canary: `ingress.trace("norm=skipped|copied", ...)` so we can see norm behavior.

josh: tests to run: microbench preparse with ascii-only vs utf8-heavy, measure write syscall count and `alloc_count`. liam can you run microbench and push numbers?

liam: running now. local gist: https://gist.github.com/liam/mini-preparse-bench (short numbers) — ascii path: p50=1.4ms p95=2.1ms, utf8 path: p50=3.6ms p95=11.3ms and write syscalls + allocs spike on utf8 path.

claire: thanks — aligns with production telemetry. also noticed kvcache miss rate up ~2% on canary which increases preflight tokenization frequency.

josh: immediate mitigation plan: rollback selector for streaming routes (PR open), enable proxy writev coalesce flag (config change), and add a preparse ascii fast-path. I'll own the selector rollback.

liam: I'll open bench PR + add a p95 breakdown dashboard for `host.preparse.normalize_ms` and `host.writev.syscalls` so we can see before/after.

claire: SRE, can you hold canary paused until we push rollback?

sre-oncall: holding. open an incidents channel if rollback doesn't fix it by EOD. Also will add alert for sudden jump in write syscalls for ingress-proxy.

josh: small note — we should also consider KV cache prefetching for in-flight streaming sessions; misses seem to cause repeated normalize calls. long-term item.

claire: filed infra-ticket internally: INFRA-1521 "prefetch kvcache for streaming sessions".

perf-bot: benchmark run queued: bench/175001/rollout-try — will report in-thread when finished.

liam: quick follow-up: microbench shows enabling `proxy.coalesce_writev=true` drops syscall count by ~60% and p95 preparse drops from 11.3ms -> 4.2ms on utf8-case (local).

josh: great. prioritize rollback + coalesce flag. then we'll follow-up with fast-path PR.

claire: PRs: 1) rollback selector (in review) 2) proxy config flip (ops change) 3) parse fast-path (draft). I'll link them once ready.

sre-oncall: copied action items. will unpause canary after rollback and one successful perf CI run.

claire: thanks team. short-term goal: remove the 10-15ms p95 tail. medium-term: reduce normalize copies and improve kvcache prefetching. :thumbsup:
